verdict.rationale: An official Raygun MCP server is documented (MindscapeHQ/mcp-server-raygun), so an agent has a route to error data. Raygun captures full stack traces, prioritizes errors by users affected and occurrence count, and supports triage through error statuses (resolve, ignore by condition). However, there is no evidence of what the MCP server actually exposes, and the external access token covers only deployment and upload services. There is no public OpenAPI spec, and no documented issue-tracker integration for filing bugs; PagerDuty incident creation is not a bug tracker. Missing for 10: documented MCP/API tools for pulling top issues with stack traces, a programmatic error-read API, an issue-tracker integration (e.g. Jira or GitHub Issues) for filing bugs, and hands-on corroboration of an agent workflow.
